description: Synthetic holdout corpus authored after the development benchmark; never used to tune retrieval.

documents.title: Archive Recovery Procedure
documents.text: Archived project folders are recovered through the records desk. Recovery requests are processed within two business days.

documents.title: Queue Retry Settings
documents.text: QUEUE_RETRY_LIMIT is 7. Messages that exhaust their retries go to the quarantine queue for manual inspection.

documents.title: Laptop Replacement Procedure
documents.text: Lost laptops must be reported to the device response team within one hour. Replacement laptops are collected from the equipment room.

documents.title: Cache Maintenance
documents.text: Cache maintenance runs each Wednesday at 04:00 UTC. During maintenance, requests bypass the cache and read from the primary datastore.

documents.title: Dataset Export Format
documents.text: Dataset exports use newline-delimited JSON encoded as UTF-8. Each export includes a manifest with record counts and SHA-256 checksums.

documents.title: Runbook RB-732
documents.text: RB-732 restores the search replica from a snapshot. Before restoring, pause the indexing scheduler.

documents.title: Invoice Reconciliation
documents.text: Supplier invoices are reconciled on the fifth business day of each month. Discrepancies are assigned to the accounts payable lead.

documents.title: Equipment Reimbursement
documents.text: Home office equipment reimbursement is capped at 350 dollars per calendar year. Claims require an itemized receipt.

documents.title: Contract CT-918
documents.text: Contract CT-918 has a termination fee of 73000 dollars. Reference HOLDOUT-LEGAL-821.

documents.title: Merger Project Cedar
documents.text: Project Cedar is a confidential merger scheduled for August. Reference HOLDOUT-OTHER-603.
